chapters.title: Introduction
chapters.description: Missingness mechanisms, identifiability, and the questions that come before choosing a method.

chapters.title: The EM algorithm
chapters.description: Build likelihood-based inference from the complete-data problem, one conditional expectation at a time.

chapters.title: Regression with missing covariates
chapters.description: Apply maximum likelihood and the method of weights to incomplete regression data.

chapters.title: Advanced topics in EM
chapters.description: Extend the algorithm to nonparametric estimation, information calculations, and conditional maximization.

chapters.title: Multiple imputation & Bayesian analysis
chapters.description: Represent uncertainty about missing values through posterior distributions and repeated completed datasets.

chapters.title: The estimating equation approach
chapters.description: Move from likelihoods to estimating equations, inverse probability weighting, and double robustness.

chapters.title: Conclusion
chapters.description: Reconnect the assumptions, algorithms, and inferential ideas developed throughout the course.
